e.title: SCOR GenAI 机会与风险
e.summary: SCOR（再保巨头）谈 GenAI：机遇与风险的再保险人视角
e.body:
SCOR（全球再保险公司）Highlight GenAI opportunities and risks：再保险人对生成式 AI 的评估——机遇（效率/分析）与风险（治理/合规）。对 RIAA：再保险人的 GenAI 视角——与 [[lma-ai-adoption]]（伦敦市场）、[[aae-ai-act-position]]（监管立场）配套：再保人如何权衡 GenAI；理解「GenAI 在再保险的落地考量」；再保方向（[[rim530]]）求职/研究的行业观点；AI 治理谈资的再保险维度。

e.summary_en: SCOR (global reinsurer) on GenAI: opportunities and risks from a reinsurer's perspective
e.summary_hk: SCOR（再保巨頭）談 GenAI：機遇與風險的再保險人視角
e.body_en:
SCOR (the global reinsurer) highlights GenAI opportunities and risks: a reinsurer's assessment of generative AI — opportunities (efficiency/analytics) and risks (governance/compliance). For RIAA: a reinsurer's GenAI view — with [[lma-ai-adoption]] (London market) and [[aae-ai-act-position]] (regulatory stance) it frames how reinsurers weigh GenAI; understand 'GenAI adoption considerations in reinsurance'; industry views for reinsurance-direction ([[rim530]]) jobs/research; the reinsurance dimension of AI-governance talking points.
